clauses.rule: A level 1 Direct spell costing 2 MP stabilizes one dying character within one meter; stabilization stops death tests.
clauses.limitations: The recognized Core spell now warns for GM resolution instead of invoking the first-aid workflow on the current token selection. The GM confirms one dying recipient and the one-meter distance and manually manages death tests; first aid is separate. The Ayleid Flesh Shaper exception allowing Stabilize to treat wounds (Core p. 44) is manual. The current death-test marker is coupled to first aid and wound-penalty suppression, so safe automatic stabilization remains incomplete. An older copy without identifiable Core provenance can still invoke the former handler. Previously applied first-aid markers and paid casts are not reversed. Verify cancellation, permissions, pending death tests and source identity in Foundry.

clauses.rule: A level 2 Direct spell costing 9 MP removes Paralyzed from one character within one meter.
clauses.limitations: On a successful recognized Core cast, the caster receives manual GM guidance; the condition is not removed automatically. The GM confirms one recipient, distance and the origin of the condition before resolving it. Older unrecognized copies may not show the warning. Costs, cancellations, condition sources and repeat actions require live verification.

Check all levels, wounded and full-health targets, effects, receipts, interruption and cancellation in Foundry. clauses.rule: One character within one meter regains the lower of Spell Strength and Casting Cost in MP. Levels 1–7 cost 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19 and 22 MP and have strengths 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14.
clauses.limitations: The Core spell previously could resolve without an application panel; the configured restoration is now routed to a pending outcome for recognized, unaltered Core Items. The GM must confirm the one-meter range. The implementation uses the recorded casting spend as the cap; cost reductions and all levels need live verification. Enchanted Items and casts without Magicka are held for GM resolution of Casting Cost. Scroll use preserves the Item on a blocked or uncertain identified restoration cast; other scrolls need separate review. Older unrecognized or edited copies and prior cards without a panel need review; inspect costs and target before repeating.

clauses.rule: A level 3 Direct spell costs 17 MP and affects one character within one meter, restoring 1 SP or removing one Fatigue level if present.
clauses.limitations: The selection and direct outcome path are not verified in Foundry. The GM must confirm the recipient is within one meter: the source's touch range type is not recognized by the current range selector, and other casting entry points also require review. Group agreement is manual; the dialog does not obtain remote consent. Reflected casts, unrecognized older copies, altered restoration settings, and old pending outcomes without a saved choice require GM review. If the chosen resource is unavailable when applied, there is no automatic switch. The compiled Item and selected revision retain legacy recipe/preference text that says to remove Fatigue first. Follow-up revision 20261030-6 authors a correction, pending native rebuild. Inspect the card, target and paid costs before retrying.
